serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Landlord: Again?! Didn’t I tell you what would happen if you didn’t stop?! You: Sorry about that… Landlord: Sorry won’t cut it no more! If it happens one more time I’m going to fine you! You: Fine me? There was nothing like that in my contract? Landlord: Then I guess your contract just changed. {{wi}}KEEP IT DOWN, YOU BEAST! HAVE YOU NO SHAME?! He’s for sure making more racket right now than we were just a minute before… Landlord: 500$ should be fine for now, huehehehehe~
